## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- HyperMillStrategyEngine
- recommends Optimised Roughing for freeform 3D roughing
- recommends Pocket Milling for 2D pocket roughing
- prefers Z Level Finishing for steep walls >60°

- warns for rest machining without previous roughing
